rows.text: • FULL YEAR FY 2027 DILUTED EPS GUIDANCE RAISED TO RANGE OF $7.80-$7.95, INCLUDING AN APPROXIMATE $0.52 BENEFIT RELATED TO IEEPA TARIFF NET REFUNDS RECEIVED (2)
